idPolicy: PR3-xx IDs stay stable. This round is PR4-F01…PR4-F10. Do not claim PR3-01…14 all closed. Original OD-01…OD-18 stay frozen in docs/review-2026-09-07/.

findings.title: diffHash and receipts bind the frozen changeset
findings.acceptance: After approval, swapping worktree bytes at the same path invalidates the receipt. Apply writes the frozen candidate snapshot.

findings.title: Write-time expected-before check
findings.acceptance: A user edit after conflict preflight is not overwritten.

findings.title: Journal recovery is honest
findings.acceptance: Corrupt JSON is BATCH_RECOVERY_BLOCKED. User repairs after half-apply are kept. Good replay (P02) still restores.

findings.title: Journal paths stay in the path jail
findings.acceptance: ../ in a journal does not write outside the project.

findings.title: className comes from the selected node
findings.acceptance: main p-8 plus button indigo: emerald intent edits the button in source and on the canvas, not p-8.

findings.title: sliceEdits roundtrips
findings.acceptance: apply(before, sliceEdits(before, after)) === after for a long button label plus shadow-lg.

findings.title: One writer and honest ack
findings.acceptance: Second runtime is RUNTIME_BUSY. writeCanvas ackRevision equals the version on disk.

findings.title: Debug receipts are not human approval
findings.acceptance: Reject writes nothing. HTTP receipts are labeled debug-http and bind the exact diff hash.

findings.title: Before-images keyed by workspace and worktree
findings.acceptance: Binary and unreadable are not stored as absent.

findings.title: Keyword fallback must not invert intent
findings.acceptance: 不要改颜色，只去掉阴影 does not add shadow-lg. Unsupported intents refuse and include currentClassName.
